diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Seeed wiki specification table: 'Mini. Wokring Voltage DC 4.5V ... Working Voltage 5V~24V'. YF-S201 product sheet: 'Working Voltage: 5 to 18V DC (min tested working voltage 4.5V)'. The second reading took the nominal 5 V lower bound; the documented minimum is 4.5 V, and the part still recommends powering from 5 V.

diffs.diff: flow rate (L/min) from pulse frequency in Hz: datasheet reading gives 0.13333333 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Datasheet: 'Flow rate pulse characteristics: Frequency (Hz) = 7.5 * Flow rate (L/min)', 'Pulses per Liter: 450'. Q = F / 7.5 = 0.13333 x F, which is the same constant. The model encodes it as sim.pulse.hzPerUnit = 7.5 (and the driver as HZ_PER_LPM = 7.5, Q = n/dt/k). The gate only reads measure/response/analog scales, so it doesn't see the pulse-sensor constant.
